:root{--bg:#08101c;--panel:#111a2b;--panel2:#18233a;--text:#edf4ff;--muted:#9fb1ca;--line:#2b3b5c;--accent:#66d7ff;--accent2:#85ffba;--warn:#ffd166;--danger:#ff8383}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#07101b,#0b1322 35%,#08101c);color:var(--text);line-height:1.45}

.hero{padding:34px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#13213a,#0e1728 55%,#15233d)}
.kicker{color:var(--accent);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase}
h1{font-size:42px;margin:7px 0 10px;line-height:1.08} h2{margin:0;font-size:22px} h3{margin-top:0}
.muted,.note{color:var(--muted)}
.metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:24px}
.metric{padding:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px}
.value{font-size:30px;font-weight:850} .label{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
section{margin-top:26px} .section-title{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:12px}
.card{padding:22px} .grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px} th,td{padding:9px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
th{text-align:left;color:#cbd8ec;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);position:sticky;top:0}
.num{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap} .table-wrap{overflow:auto;max-height:720px}
.detail{min-width:1450px}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.ok{color:var(--accent2);background:rgba(133,255,186,.1);border:1px solid rgba(133,255,186,.22)}
.warn{color:var(--warn);background:rgba(255,209,102,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,209,102,.22)}
.info{color:var(--accent);background:rgba(102,215,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(102,215,255,.22)}
.timeline{display:grid;gap:10px} .event{border-left:3px solid var(--accent);padding:9px 0 9px 13px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(102,215,255,.055),transparent)}
ul{padding-left:20px} .footer{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-top:36px}
@media(max-width:900px){.metrics,.grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:600px){.metrics,.grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}h1{font-size:32px}.wrap{padding:20px 12px 40px}}
.collapsible-section{
margin-top:26px;
background:transparent;
}

<body><div class="wrap">
<div class="hero">
<div class="kicker">#teamcorc · Stallion VTOL V2 Manufacturing</div>
<h1>Detailed 3D Printing Report</h1>
<p class="muted">Refreshed production report with executive summary, material usage, section-by-section part details, printer assignments, slicer settings, individual weights, print times, filament consumption, and reprint/process history.</p>
<div class="metrics">
<div class="metric"><div class="value">67</div><div class="label">Accepted printed components</div></div>
<div class="metric"><div class="value">895 g</div><div class="label">Accepted printed-part mass</div></div>
<div class="metric"><div class="value">415.920 m*</div><div class="label">Known filament consumed</div></div>
<div class="metric"><div class="value">91h 49m*</div><div class="label">Known recorded print time</div></div>
</div>
</div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:flex-end;margin:18px 0 4px">
<button id="expand-all" class="section-toggle" style="width:auto;padding:9px 14px;font-size:13px">Expand all</button>
<button id="collapse-all" class="section-toggle" style="width:auto;padding:9px 14px;font-size:13px">Collapse all</button>
</div>
<section class="grid2">
<div class="card">
<h3>Material Summary</h3>
<table>
<tr><th>Material Group</th><th class="num">Weight</th><th class="num">Filament</th><th class="num">Time</th></tr>
<tr><td><a href="https://us.polymaker.com/products/polylite-lw-pla" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:700">Polymaker PolyLite LW-PLA ↗</a> — Gray / White</td><td class="num">650 g</td><td class="num">321.225 m*</td><td class="num">65 h 54 m*</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="https://overture3d.com/products/overture-petg" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:700">Overture PETG ↗</a> — White / Red</td><td class="num">244 g</td><td class="num">94.346 m</td><td class="num">25 h 48 m</td></tr>
<tr><td>Generic PLA — Transparent</td><td class="num">1 g</td><td class="num">0.349 m</td><td class="num">7 m</td></tr>
<tr><th>Total</th><th class="num">895 g</th><th class="num">415.920 m*</th><th class="num">91 h 49 m*</th></tr>
</table>
<p class="muted">The 895 g figure is printed-component mass only, not final empty weight or AUW. *Tail 1 print time and filament were not recorded, so filament/time totals are known minimums.</p>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h3>Current Process Baseline</h3>
<p><strong>Primary slicer:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/releases/tag/v2.4.2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:700">OrcaSlicer v2.4.2 ↗</a></p>
<div class="timeline">
<div class="event"><strong>LW-PLA aerodynamic parts:</strong> primarily OrcaSlicer with 1 wall and low-density Gyroid or Lateral Lattice infill.</div>
<div class="event"><strong>Structural PETG:</strong> generally 3 walls with 20% Grid or Cubic depending on part.</div>
<div class="event"><strong>Thin-wall boom parts:</strong> OrcaSlicer works correctly when <b>Detect Thin Walls</b> is enabled and <b>Wall Generator = Arachne</b>.</div>
<div class="event"><strong>Transparent LED covers:</strong> Detect Thin Walls enabled.</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="collapsible-section">
<button class="section-toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="section-1">
<span class="title">Key Manufacturing Findings</span>
<span class="summary">Updated to reflect the latest validated slicer configuration</span>
<span class="arrow">▼</span>
</button>
<div class="section-content" id="section-1">
<div class="grid2">
<div class="card">
<h3><a href="https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/releases/tag/v2.4.2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color:var(--text);text-decoration:none">OrcaSlicer v2.4.2 ↗</a> — Thin-Wall Configuration</h3>
<p><b>BOOM TAIL INSERT, BOOM FUS INSERT, and BOOM FUS MOUNT</b> do not require Cura. They can be sliced successfully in OrcaSlicer with:</p>
<ul><li><b>Detect Thin Walls:</b> Enabled</li><li><b>Wall Generator:</b> Arachne</li></ul>
<p class="muted">This supersedes the earlier interim note that Cura was required.</p>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h3>Replacement / Reprint Notes</h3>
<ul>
<li><b>Custom rear motor mount:</b> original split; replacement uses separate Top-Rear-Motor-Mount and Bottom-Rear-Motor-Mount parts.</li>
<li><b>TAIL 1:</b> accepted as final part (18 g); print time and filament were not recorded.</li>
<li><b>Wing Lock Assembly:</b> Neptune 2S Base + Front L/R + Rear L/R assembly accepted as final.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<button class="section-toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="section-2">

<span class="summary">10 accepted line items · 219.0 g recorded · 110.919 m recorded · 22h 16m recorded</span>
<span class="arrow">▼</span>
</button>
